root_cause: The legacy content lesson function treated any non-zero reactions/clicks as success and aggregated LinkedIn before preserving personal-vs-company channel identity.
fix: Normalize weak outcomes, keep personal/company LinkedIn as separate experiment arms, forbid cross-post reuse, keep personal free of commercial CTA optimization and make company revenue/value oriented.
prevention: Never call an absolute non-zero metric a winner without a normalized threshold.
Never transfer social learnings across channel identities without explicit evidence.
Company content optimizes for qualified action/revenue; personal content preserves personal identity first.
